headline: Investment gains lift profit as underwriting softens
summary_short: Net income rose to $322.3M (+57.7% y/y) on investment gains, but net operating income excluding those gains fell to $186.0M (-11.1% y/y) as the consolidated combined ratio widened to 95.3% from 93.6%, with Specialty Insurance underwriting weakness only partly offset by a strong Title Insurance rebound.
summary_long: Revenue rose 13.4% y/y to $2,503.4M and net income rose 57.7% y/y to $322.3M, but net operating income (excluding investment gains) fell 11.1% y/y to $186.0M as the consolidated combined ratio widened to 95.3% from 93.6%. Specialty Insurance's combined ratio rose to 95.5% from 90.7% on unfavorable prior-year reserve development in run-off transactional risk plus an elevated expense ratio from technology and start-up investments; its underwriting income fell 50.5% y/y. Title Insurance's combined ratio improved to 95.1% from 99.0% as premiums grew 10.7% and underwriting income rose to $37.6M from $6.9M. Book value per share rose 7.2% since year-end to $25.33; cash was $417.7M. The company returned $137.4M to shareholders and closed the ECM acquisition July 1.

drivers.explanation: Boosted by $172.4M of pretax net investment gains, mostly unrealized equity fair-value gains, which offset an 11.1% y/y decline in net operating income (income excluding investment gains).
GAAP diluted EPS of $1.31 included $0.55/share of net investment gains; diluted EPS excluding those gains (net operating income per share) was $0.76, down 9.3% y/y.

Consolidated net premiums and fees grew 5.2% on 2.3% Specialty Insurance growth (rate increases and new business, partly offset by lower renewal retention) and 10.7% Title Insurance growth (higher agency and commercial production).

Consolidated combined ratio widened to 95.3% from 93.6% as Specialty Insurance's ratio rose to 95.5% (unfavorable run-off reserve development, elevated expense ratio) while Title Insurance's ratio improved to 95.1% from 99.0% on premium growth.
Cash rose aided by proceeds from a $700M Senior Notes issuance in May 2026, issued ahead of the August 2026 maturity of $550M in existing notes.
